cases.prompt: What does MBS("Dialog.SetMessage") do, what parameters does it take, and will it run on FileMaker Server?
must: Resolves the Dialog component through references/index.json to its group file and answers from the catalog entry
Gives the signature and parameters from the entry
States the status from the entry (free)
Says it is not supported on Server (compatibility.server is false)
must_not: Answers from memory without opening the catalog

cases.prompt: My legacy script calls MBS("Calendar.NewEvent"). Is that still OK for new work?
must: Reports deprecated: true and that it still runs
Points to the newer Events component as the replacement
Mentions it is macOS only and licensed

cases.prompt: Can I create PDFs with MBS DynaPDF.New on our existing MBS licence?
must: Says DynaPDF needs a separate DynaPDF licence on top of the base MBS registration
Sends the user to Monkeybread for current pricing
must_not: Quotes a specific dollar price as current

cases.prompt: Show me a FileMaker script that uses MBS CURL to download a URL, so I can add it to my file.
must: Gives readable script steps (Set Variable [ ... ] lines) based on the catalog examples
Says to write the steps into the file through ADT when installed, or enter them by hand
must_not: Produces fmxmlsnippet or any clipboard XML

cases.prompt: What does the MBS Trace function do?
must: Finds the dot-less function under its own component key Trace in references/index.json
Returns its description and free status
must_not: Says the function does not exist

near_misses: What's the syntax for FileMaker's JSONSetElement? (claris-filemaker-pro)
